Specification: Small ESP32 board with USB port
Notes: Tested: LOLIN S2 Mini. ESP32-C3 Super Mini is planned for future builds. The board must fit inside the lamp base; boards larger than the S2 Mini may not fit. The USB port must remain accessible because it provides power and is used for setup.
Tested: BTF-LIGHTING WS2812B ECO. 60 LEDs/m spacing is required. ECO LEDs keep the full-white load suitable for ordinary USB power.
Enough for the maximum LED current of 1.12 A. One wire each for 5 V, GND, and data.
Holds the ESP32 to the base.
Glues the clip unit into the top plug.
Connects to the ESP32 USB port and powers the lamp. This is intentionally not included in the BOM because many builders already have a suitable cable and adapter.
Needed to make the six solder joints between the LED strip and ESP32.
